## Summary

`terraform plan` could not run at all against `infra/terraform`. `templatefile()` interpolates
the WHOLE file (comments included) as HCL, so unescaped `${...}` in `user_data.sh` **comments**
broke every terraform operation on the box:

    Call to function "templatefile" failed: ./user_data.sh:92,24-25: Invalid character;
    This character is not used within the language., and 3 other diagnostic(s).

## Root cause

Commit `ef1a7e66a65d` ("Gate standalone shell scripts with ShellCheck",
`rebar-ticket: fe4e-54a5-3c3a-4901`) added explanatory comments that escaped the FIRST mention
of a bash brace expansion as `$${...}` but left the "reduces to"/"becomes" half UNESCAPED. Three
sites, all inside `#` comments, referencing the bash array `PARAMS` (not a template variable):
`user_data.sh:92:14`, `:92:30`, `:111:46`. `main.tf:63` declares exactly one template variable,
`data_volume_id`; the four `${data_volume_id}` sites are legitimate and must stay unescaped.

Class: **regression** — `terraform plan` ran green before `ef1a7e66a65d` and failed after, on an
otherwise-untouched config. `caused_by fe4e-54a5-3c3a-4901`.

## Fix (LANDED)

Fix commit `13e2ea6decc9` (`rebar-ticket: dd30-f10d-69f3-4c36`), an ancestor of `origin/main`:

1. `infra/terraform/user_data.sh` — reworded the three comment sites so no unescaped `${` remains
   and the explanation still reads correctly.
2. `scripts/check_templatefile_escapes.py` (new) — declared-variable-aware regression guard that
   escape-aware-scans every `templatefile()` template against its call's variable map and fails
   on any interpolation naming an undeclared root. ShellCheck cannot catch this class.
3. `Makefile` — guard wired into `make lint` (`Makefile:312`).
4. `tests/unit/test_check_templatefile_escapes.py` — RED/GREEN/mutation coverage (19 passed).

Full RCA, discriminating experiments, and re-verification evidence are in the ticket comments.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The three broken comment sites carry no unescaped `${`; the four legitimate
      `${data_volume_id}` sites (`:25,:28,:53,:56`) are intact. Codebase-verifiable on
      `origin/main`: the guard exits 0.
- [x] A regression guard rejects an unescaped `${` in any `templatefile()`-consumed file, wired
      into `make lint`. Codebase-verifiable: `scripts/check_templatefile_escapes.py` +
      `Makefile:312` + `tests/unit/test_check_templatefile_escapes.py` (19 passed).
- [x] `terraform plan` / `templatefile()` renders the template cleanly (P1 breakage gone).
      [non-codebase] Re-verified today: real `terraform` v1.15.8 renders `origin/main`'s file
      (exit 0) and the reported `Invalid character` diagnostic reproduces only on the pre-fix
      file. Evidence in the re-verification comment.
- [x] LIVE `terraform apply` — DEFERRED to an operator-supervised deploy window (NOT run; not
      claimed as executed). [non-codebase] Out of scope for this `templatefile()` CODE bug and
      not runnable autonomously: a clean apply currently shares one physical apply with the
      `value_wo` secrets migration on `ssm.tf`, which would overwrite prod SecureString values
      with `CHANGEME`. Tracked on `polonium-deceptive-antelope` (f268-32ae-4ea9-42fb) and the
      value_wo cutover `097b-de23-bf12-4c38`. Re-scoped (not `--force`d) so the landed code fix
      closes on its own merit.

## Note

The agent that found this deliberately did NOT edit `user_data.sh` to unblock itself — it feeds
production `user_data` and belonged in its own reviewed change. That change is `13e2ea6decc9`.
